text:
Erin Zhou: ok this is ridiculous — my upstairs roommate just turned on their vacuum and my video call turned into a robot opera. who has tips for making a 'desk fort' that actually blocks noise? 😂
Ben: noise-cancelling headphones are great but if you're going full fort mode, cheap trick: blanket over bookshelf + clamps, leaves a little vent for plants. works surprisingly well. :house_with_garden:
Alice M.: also try moving mic off the desk. desk vibrations travel. put a folded tshirt under the mic stand. tiny life hack.
Erin Zhou: doing that rn. also my home wifi decided it's auditioning for intermittent drama — dropped during a call earlier. speedtest attached: 
```
Ping: 24 ms
Download: 7.2 Mbps
Upload: 0.9 Mbps
```
Carlos: yikes on the upload. are you on ISP basic plan or satellite? sometimes ISP throttles during evening. if you're on a mesh, try powering off all nodes, bring main node up first, then add others (resets routing).
Dana: you could also bribe the roommate with snacks and a 'vacuum schedule' sticky note. 10/10 has worked for me. :baguette_bread: :star2:
Ben: curious — what router model? some of them have QoS rules where you can prioritize 'video' or a device. plop your laptop MAC into high priority and see if it helps.
Erin Zhou: router is a cheap ISP-provided one, no QoS :/ can I slap a travel router in front of it?
Carlos: yes, travel router in AP mode or a small Ubiquiti in front works. alternative: tether phone on 5G for meetings as fallback.
wifi-bot: ISP outage reported in your area earlier today (ID: #2026-11-WIFI). Estimated clear: 1912349800. Please check provider status page for updates.
Erin Zhou: oof outage window into the future lol. thanks for the tips. I'm going to try the blanket-fort + tshirt-mic + phone-tether failover. will report back with pics.
Dana: obligatory: if you do fort pics, you must post. community standards. :camera_with_flash: :thumbsup:
Alice M.: also if you want, I have a spare travel router you can borrow for a week — PM me.
Ben: if all else fails, stage whisper: "the vacuum loves me" and pretend it's part of the meeting.
Erin Zhou: noted. thanks team. fort construction commencing. updates incoming (pics & possibly a dramatic vacuum showdown).
